title: Add four numbers
task: Show on OUT the sum of the four bytes at a, b, c and d, then stop. The sum is taken modulo 256, as the adder-subtracter does. Keep the four labels and their DB lines: the tests write the numbers there.
starter:
; sum-four -- practice exercise (MAVILERA, SAP-1)
; Show on OUT the sum of the bytes at a, b, c and d.
; Hint: load one, add the others, then OUT and HLT.
        HLT           ; replace with your code

        ORG 0CH       ; the data at the end of the memory
a:      DB 0
b:      DB 0
c:      DB 0
d:      DB 0
